# Block Blast 2 artwork attribution

`app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/gridblocks_glass.png` is the **Glass Arcade**
skin atlas from the Block Blast 2 project:

- Source: <https://github.com/giveuper39/Block-Blast-2>
- File: `fair-mod/assets/skin-masters/glass.png`
- Copyright: 2026 Block Blast 2 contributors
- License: MIT (generated skin artwork and patch code are MIT licensed by the
  upstream project; original Block Blast artwork is excluded upstream)

The atlas is used unchanged as a source texture. GridBlocks crops its eight cells
at runtime for the six playable block colours and does not use Block Blast 2
branding, menus, music, or game code.
